subject: Consolidated billing cadence for pilot → enterprise (request for Net-90 on later invoices)
messages:
From: Lauren Park <lauren@summit.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@summit.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated billing for pilot → enterprise: request for Net-90 on later invoices

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement asked me to propose an invoicing cadence that aligns with our Q-tracker and cash forecasts.

Proposal:
- SOW execution: invoice 100% of pilot agreed amount (due on receipt)
- When we convert to enterprise (expected Q4): invoice on a quarterly cadence (4 invoices across the first year)
- For the enterprise invoices only: request Net-90 payment terms (our fiscal cutoff)
- We can sign now; we also attached a suggested payment plan and the SOW for review.

Files attached:
- SummitAI_PaymentPlan.xlsx
- SOW_Q3_SummitAI.pdf

We appreciate flexibility here. SummitAI is committed to a multi-year rollout; granting Net-90 on the enterprise invoices would keep us moving this quarter.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can approve Net-90 for the post-pilot invoices and whether there are any required upsides (e.g., upfront deposit, credit hold triggers)?

Thanks,
Lauren Park
VP Finance, Summit AI
lauren@summit.ai
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Park <lauren@summit.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated billing for pilot → enterprise: request for Net-90 on later invoices

Hi Lauren — thanks for outlining this and for the attachments (received). I appreciate the heads-up on SummitAI's fiscal timing.

Quick summary for internal reviewers: Summit is asking that: pilot be invoiced on sign (standard), and that once they move to enterprise we invoice quarterly for the first year and allow Net-90 on those enterprise invoices rather than our standard Net-30. They are open to contractual guardrails but would like flexibility to close the deal this quarter.

Marissa / Karthik / Markus — can you weigh in on risk and whether Exec approval is required? Specifically: 1) Net-90 on enterprise invoices; 2) whether we require an upfront portion (what %); 3) any legal language or credit/security we should insist on.

Attaching the customer's payment plan and SOW for reference.

[attachment: SummitAI_PaymentPlan.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[attachment: SOW_Q3_SummitAI.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 10:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated billing for pilot → enterprise: request for Net-90 on later invoices

Mina — thanks for pulling this together. High level: Net-90 materially increases DSO and cash exposure for Redwood for the enterprise invoices. A few thoughts from finance:

- Conditional approval possible if SummitAI agrees to one of the following upsides: 1) 25% upfront at execution (applies to pilot + holdback against first enterprise invoice), or 2) 100% of pilot on execution + 25% of first enterprise quarter paid within 30 days.
- Require credit review / trade reference check before final approval.
- Add a credit hold trigger at 60 days past due on any invoice that moves the account into collections after 90 days.
- Revenue recognition note: we need sign-off from RevRec on any billing deviance; please add RevRec@redwood.com to the loop if you proceed.

If legal can draft a short addendum capturing the payment milestone and late-remedy flow, I can greenlight once the upfront condition is accepted.

-Karthik
Director, Finance (Commercial)
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated billing for pilot → enterprise: request for Net-90 on later invoices

On Sat, 29 Aug 2026 at 09:12 Lauren Park <lauren@summit.ai> wrote:
> Hi Mina,
> 
> Thanks again for the demo yesterday... (trimmed)

We can draft an amendment that permits Net-90 on specified future invoices with the following guardrails:
- Explicit schedule of invoices (attach schedule to SOW)
- 25% upfront payment at execution (applies to pilot, credited to first enterprise invoice)
- Late remedy: 1.5% per month after Net-90, plus the right to suspend access if two consecutive enterprise invoices are >120 days overdue
- Standard indemnity & data handling clauses remain unchanged

I will prepare a short addendum and upload to DocuSign; link to sign will follow. If Sales confirms no additional commercial concessions (discounts), legal is comfortable with conditional approval.

-Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Park <lauren@summit.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval: SummitAI payment cadence (conditional)

Hi team / Lauren,

After reviewing the risks and the legal addendum Markus will prepare, I approve the requested deviation from standard terms with the following conditions:

1) Upfront requirement: 25% of total pilot fee due on execution (captured in SOW). Pilot invoice will be paid on receipt.
2) Enterprise invoices: allowed to be billed on a quarterly cadence with Net-90 payment terms for the enterprise invoices only (first enterprise invoice credited with the upfront payment).
3) No additional commercial discount beyond standard EAA pricing; any request for a price concession must be separately approved by RevOps.
4) Credit and RevRec clearance required before SOW is countersigned.
5) Late-remedy and suspension clause as drafted by legal will be included in the addendum.

Mina / Marissa — please get the credit check scheduled and have Markus push the DocuSign package. Once signed and the upfront payment clears, finance will remove the account from any collections-triggered holds and we will proceed.

Lauren — happy to move forward once the addendum is signed and the 25% upfront is received. If you want, we can include a short note in the SOW to call out the enterprise quarterly cadence for the first 12 months.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

On Tue, 29 Aug 2026 at 10:01 Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com> wrote:
